comparison.objective: Candidate removes HELICOIL tangs; record sorts sample tubes, isolating a leaking one and calling a technician.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires aligned hammering and tiny-fragment collection; record requires leak recognition, tube-to-slot loading, exception sorting, and button actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four undamaged insert completions and complete tang recovery; record requires good tubes loaded one per slot, the leaking tube in the yellow tray, and the red call button pressed.
comparison.reason: Hazard recognition and conditional specimen handling are materially different.
